validation.email: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the information is not valid. Please check the form and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email address or password is incorrect.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Your email address has not been confirmed yet. Use the link we emailed you.

login.title: Sign in
login.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: An account lets you manage your information in one place. We only ask for what we need.
register.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy
register.termsRequired: You need to accept the terms to create an account.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {{ email }}.
checkEmail.instructions: Open the email and follow the link to activate your account. The link is valid for 24 hours. If you cannot find it, look in your spam folder.
checkEmail.resent: If your account still needs confirming, a new email is on its way.

verifyEmail.title: Email confirmation
verifyEmail.success: Your email address is confirmed. You can now sign in.
verifyEmail.failed: We could not confirm your email address.
verifyEmail.failedHelp: The link may have expired or already been used. Try signing in: if your address still needs confirming, you can ask for a new link there.

forgotPassword.title: Forgotten password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has been sent. It is valid for 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.success: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.

home.title: Equipment, care and services, in one accessible place
home.lead: InclusiveCare brings together what people with disabilities, their families and their caregivers need every day.

accessible.title: Accessible by design
accessible.text: Works with a keyboard, a screen reader or a phone. Adjust text size and contrast at any time.

private.title: Your data stays yours
private.text: We collect as little as possible, and you can delete your account whenever you want.

multilingual.title: In your language
multilingual.text: Available in French, English and Arabic.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you asked for does not exist or has moved.

dashboard.intro: This is your starting point. More services will appear here as they open.

account.title: My account
account.text: Update your name, change your password or delete your account.

accessibility.title: Display settings
accessibility.text: Text size, contrast, animations and simplified layout.

adminUsers.title: User management
adminUsers.text: Find users, manage their roles and suspend accounts.

password.title: Password
password.intro: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.intro: This closes your account and erases your personal information. It cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm it is you.
delete.confirmMessage: Your account will be closed and your personal information erased. This cannot be undone.

a11y.title: Display settings
a11y.intro: Adjust how InclusiveCare looks. Changes apply immediately.
a11y.savedAutomatically: Your choices are saved automatically on this device, and on your account when you are signed in.

adminUser.back: Back to the list of users
adminUser.selfNotice: This is your own account. Administrators cannot change their own roles or status.
adminUser.suspendHelp: Suspending signs the user out immediately and prevents them from signing in.
adminUser.reactivateHelp: This account is suspended. Reactivating lets the user sign in again.
adminUser.suspendConfirmMessage: {{ name }} will be signed out immediately and will not be able to sign in.
